settings.title: TintaView Settings
settings.wizard.tooltip: Open the full console setup wizard in a terminal for hooks, autostart, and engine-specific options (OpenRGB host/port, G HUB path, ...).
settings.agents.hint: Drag to reorder — the order here is also the flyout/tooltip order.
settings.chime: Sound when an agent needs confirmation
settings.language.hint: The setup wizard stays in English, and figures an agent's own API reports keep their original wording.
settings.colors.note: Applies to the tray icon and your device lighting.
settings.colors.note_tooltip: Left alone, each status keeps its own default on each side: the icon uses the TintaView mark's hues, the hardware a more saturated version that reads better through an LED diffuser.
settings.error.no_agents: Pick at least one agent — TintaView needs one to have anything to show.
